objective.text: Restore and release a lock using its owner token across a process boundary.

difficulty.rationale: Transfer the capability to release a lock without acquiring an unrelated owner identity.

runtime.sapi: Isolated CLI Laravel harness unless another context is explicitly stated
runtime.errorPolicy: E_ALL; UTC; no external services or application data

assumptions: The receiving worker uses the same shared lock store; the acquired lock has not expired.

stem: A web request acquires a lock and delegates completion to a job. Which value and operation let that job release this particular lock with ownership checking?

options.text: Pass the cache prefix and call Cache::forget($name).
options.rationale: A generic value deletion does not express the lock provider’s ownership-checked release contract.
options.misconception: A generic value deletion does not express the lock provider’s ownership-checked release contract.

options.rationale: The owner token restores the identity associated with the acquired lock, allowing an ownership-checked release.

options.text: Pass the lock name and call lock($name)->release() with a new token.
options.rationale: A newly constructed lock has a different owner and cannot normally release the existing owner’s lock.
options.misconception: A newly constructed lock has a different owner and cannot normally release the existing owner’s lock.

options.text: Pass the request URL and call forceRelease on any matching name.
options.rationale: forceRelease bypasses ownership, and a request URL is not the lock owner token.
options.misconception: forceRelease bypasses ownership, and a request URL is not the lock owner token.
